label: AS4610-30T 1G open switch
description: Edgecore AS4610-30T 1RU bare-metal L3 switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 1x 1G RJ-45 management port and a serial console, plus 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking ports that are not modelled as data ports. 104 Gbps switching capacity, 156 Mpps, 76.1 W maximum system power. ONIE only - no NOS in the box. End of life 30 June 2025.

fabric.note: Series datasheet figure of 104 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (24 x 1G + 4 x 10G + 2 x 20G). Forwarding rate 156 Mpps in the series table; some revisions of the model datasheet print 95 Mpps in the performance section, so only the capacity is recorded here.

notes: Port count from the vendor datasheet: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, 4x SFP+ (10G or 1G), 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking.Broadcom BCM56340 Helix4 with a dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 at 1 GHz, 2 GB DDR3 SDRAM with ECC, 8 MB SPI flash, 4 MB shared packet buffer, 96 K MAC addresses, 4 K VLANs, 12 KB jumbo frames, two redundant hot-swappable AC PSUs (100-240 VAC), 1RU 44 x 35 x 4.4 cm. Ships as bare metal with ONIE, no NOS installed. The two QSFP+ stacking cages are described but not declared as interfaces: 20G is not a line rate the importer accepts, and calling them 40G QSFP+ or 10G would state a rate no datasheet gives. Console is the RJ-45 serial console, or a micro-USB serial console on the airflow variant that carries one instead; the front panel also has a USB-A (or micro-USB) storage port, which is not a network interface and is not modelled. Stacking needs a NOS that implements it. End of life effective 30 June 2025 per the EOL notice the product page links to (https://www.edge-core.com/eol-notice/2025-june-eol-notice-as4610-series/); the hardware is still in the field, so the spec stays. Sources: product page https://www.edge-core.com/product/as4610-30t/ and the AS4610 series datasheet https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54T-R09.pdf.

label: AS4610-30P PoE 1G open switch
description: Edgecore AS4610-30P 1RU bare-metal L3 PoE switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45, all PoE (802.3af/at, 8 of them UPoE at 60 W) on a 960 W budget, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 1x 1G RJ-45 management port and a serial console, plus 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking ports that are not modelled as data ports. 104 Gbps switching capacity, 156 Mpps, 81.72 W maximum system power without PoE load. ONIE only. End of life 30 June 2025.

poe.note: 960 W PoE power budget for 24 ports, from the AS4610 series specification table (802.3af 15 W on 24 ports, 802.3at 30 W on 24 ports, UPoE 60 W on 8 ports). The datasheet warning that the AC PSUs are redundant for the system and the network but not fully redundant for PoE functions and the power budget applies here too, so 960 W is a single-supply figure.

fabric.note: Series datasheet figure of 104 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (24 x 1G + 4 x 10G + 2 x 20G). Forwarding rate 156 Mpps in the series table; some revisions of the model datasheet print 95 Mpps, so only the capacity is recorded.

notes: Port count from the vendor datasheet: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE RJ-45, 4x SFP+ (10G or 1G), 2x 20G QSFP+ stacking.Broadcom BCM56340 Helix4 with a dual-core ARM Cortex-A9 at 1 GHz, 2 GB DDR3 SDRAM with ECC, 8 MB SPI flash, 4 MB shared packet buffer, 96 K MAC addresses, 4 K VLANs, 12 KB jumbo frames, two redundant hot-swappable AC PSUs (100-240 VAC), 1RU 44 x 35 x 4.4 cm. Ships as bare metal with ONIE, no NOS installed. The two QSFP+ stacking cages are described but not declared as interfaces: 20G is not a line rate the importer accepts, and calling them 40G QSFP+ or 10G would state a rate no datasheet gives. The PoE models add a fixed system fan. Every copper port is a PSE port; the datasheet states 8 of the 24 carry UPoE at 60 W but does not enumerate which eight, so each is modelled at 30 W (802.3at) and the 60 W capability is recorded here rather than guessed port by port. End of life effective 30 June 2025 (https://www.edge-core.com/eol-notice/2025-june-eol-notice-as4610-series/). Sources: product page https://www.edge-core.com/product/as4610-30p/ and the AS4610 series datasheet https://www.edge-core.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/AS4610-54T-R09.pdf.

label: AS4610-54P PoE 1G open switch

poe.note: 1650 W PoE power budget for 48 ports, from the AS4610 series specification table (802.3af 15 W on 48 ports, 802.3at 30 W on 48 ports, UPoE 60 W on 8 ports). The model datasheet is explicit that the AC PSUs are redundant for the system and the network but not fully redundant for PoE functions or the power budget, so 1650 W is a single-supply figure - and 8 x 60 W plus 40 x 30 W (1680 W) would already exceed it.

fabric.note: 128 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of the port rates (48 x 1G + 4 x 10G + 2 x 20G) and the figure on the product page and in the series table. The AS4610-54P R08 model datasheet prints 256 Gbps full duplex with a 190 Mpps forwarding rate; 256 Gbps counts every port in both directions, so 128 Gbps is recorded.

Ships as bare metal with ONIE, no NOS installed. The two QSFP+ stacking cages are described but not declared as interfaces: 20G is not a line rate the importer accepts, and calling them 40G QSFP+ or 10G would state a rate no datasheet gives.
